variants.name: V1_overnight_reversal_z1
variants.rule: 1 MBT (0.1 BTC), no stop/target, Binance BTCUSDT perp 1-min bars as CME proxy, $3.82 round turn. Topstep day d = session opening 17:00 CT on date d (Sun-Thu) and ending 15:10 CT on d+1. At the 08:29 CT bar close on d+1 compute r = close(08:29 CT) / open(17:00 CT bar of day d) - 1 (the 08:29 close is the last price before the 08:30 open); z = r / sd, sd = sample std (ddof=1) of the same window return over the 60 Topstep days preceding the scored day (min 50 valid), no mean subtracted. If |z| >= 1.0: enter at the open of the 08:30 CT bar with side = -sign(r) (fade the overnight move); exit at the open of the 15:08 CT bar the same day. Forced flat 15:10 CT as backstop.

variants.name: V5_prevday_continuation_z1
variants.rule: 1 MBT (0.1 BTC), no stop/target, Binance BTCUSDT perp 1-min bars as CME proxy, $3.82 round turn. Topstep day d = session opening 17:00 CT on date d (Sun-Thu) and ending 15:10 CT on d+1. At 16:59 CT on date d (Sun-Thu) compute r = open(15:08 CT bar of the previous Topstep day's day session) / open(17:00 CT bar that opened the previous Topstep day) - 1 (for Sunday the previous Topstep day is Thu 17:00 -> Fri 15:08); z = r / sd, sd = sample std (ddof=1) of the same window return over the 60 Topstep days preceding the scored day (min 50 valid), no mean subtracted (the 60 Topstep days preceding that previous day). If |z| >= 1.0: enter at the open of the 17:00 CT bar of date d with side = +sign(r); hold overnight and exit at the open of the 15:08 CT bar on d+1. Forced flat 15:10 CT / weekend as backstop.
